patronOf.pt-BR: O Primeiro Chamado, padroeiro da Escócia

meta.face: An old man around 70, abundant unruly curly grey-white hair, a long grey-white beard divided at the end into two points, a kindly weathered face.
meta.basis: Old man with a beard divided into two points (Painter's Manual); wild hair and long beard in the West.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
